roster.name: Aurelian the Sun-Crowned
roster.blurb: A warlord in white and gold who has never lost in the arena. Dawnbreaker lands like judgement, but all that plate makes him the slowest man on the sand.

roster.name: Varek the Oathbreaker
roster.blurb: Once a knight at Aurelian's side, cast out for breaking his vow. Quicker and harder to tire than the man he once followed, and less forgiving of his own mistakes.

roster.name: Wuixi the Crimson Fang
roster.blurb: A blade for hire who hides her face and answers to no banner. Faster than anyone in the ring and gone before the counter comes, but one clean hit hurts her more than most.
